messages.subject: Uploading Dataset to ShinyApps.io
parts:
Hi Everyone,

I'm new to R and to Shiny and I'm having a issue with my page: (https://hwangnyc.shinyapps.io/App-1/). I'm getting the error message "object 'imlp' not found", imlp being the vector for the dataset. Here is my code:

library(shiny)


shinyServer(function(input, output) {



  output$distPlot <- renderPlot({
    Bike_Time    <- imlp[, 1]  # dataset
    bins <- seq(min(Bike_Time), max(Bike_Time), length.out = input$bins + 1)

    hist(Bike_Time, breaks = bins, col = 'grey', border = 'black')
  })

})


I believe this has something to do with the dataset not being uploaded. Does anyone have any suggestions?

Thanks,
Henry

messages.subject: Re: Uploading Dataset to ShinyApps.io
parts:
Look up the read.table function or see here: http://www.inside-r.org/r-doc/utils/read.table
You'll want to use read.csv to read in your file.
If your dataset.csv is in the same directory as your server.r, it would be
imlp <- read.csv("dataset.csv")
or imlp <- read.csv("dataset.csv", header=FALSE)  if you don't have column headers.
